title: Transforming From Immorality To Beautiful Civility Returning Our Kingdom To An Organized Nation Pt 3
body:
IUIC in the ClassRoom · 2026-01-03

Opens [1 Tim 3](/bible/1-timothy/3) · [Jer 30](/bible/jeremiah/30) · [Hos 4](/bible/hosea/4) · [Ps 127](/bible/psalms/127) · [2 Cor 6](/bible/2-corinthians/6) · [Heb 13](/bible/hebrews/13) · [Wis 4](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/4) · [John 9](/bible/john/9) · [Acts 1](/bible/acts/1) · [Luke 17](/bible/luke/17) · [Matt 11](/bible/matthew/11) · [1 Tim 2](/bible/1-timothy/2) · [Sir 26](/bible/sirach/26) · [Wis 3](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/3) · [1 Pet 3](/bible/1-peter/3)
## Introduction *[[8:19](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=499s)]* In the third part of his series, Bishop Yawasap teaches that Israel cannot return from immorality to civility, or organize as a kingdom, until marriage is restored. Every sin followed the break between Adam and Eve, and the first organization of a nation is a husband and wife in God's order. The wife is the man's charging station, the source of comfort, reverence and strength that lets him go out to war for his nation. The enemy took the kingdom by force by breaking that bond, as the Willie Lynch and King Leopold letters describe. The class warns that children of unlawful unions witness against their parents, and calls men to lead righteously and women to reverence their husbands. ## In The News - *[[1:45:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=6318s)]* **Readings from the Willie Lynch letter on breaking the slave and separating the woman from her husband.** — The kingdom of heaven suffered violence, and the violent took it by force: by breaking the Israelite family. - *[[2:08:33](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=7713s)]* **The letter attributed to King Leopold instructing missionaries in the Congo to teach Africans to read but not to reason, to obey missionaries over parents, and to stay in submission.** — The same doctrine has kept Israel captive everywhere. The children were taught to obey the missionary instead of righteous parents. - *[[2:25:56](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=8756s)]* **A commentator reacts to a social media trend of women saying they hate their husbands, wishing they would cheat so they could leave, and withholding intimacy to push them to fall.** — This is contempt, the opposite of reverence, and some brothers live with it. Satan has taught Israel's women to follow Edom's women. - *[[2:42:26](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=9746s)]* **Bishop Kani says that if a husband walks in and his wife is not glad to see him, there are real problems.** — Reverence is the comfort a man needs to fight. When it is gone, the house is lost. ## Scriptures Opened **[1 Timothy 3:4](/bible/1-timothy/3#v4)** *[[13:27](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=807s)]* > [4](/bible/1-timothy/3#v4) One that ruleth well his own house, having his children in subjection with all gravity; - A leader must rule well his own house, for if a man know not how to rule his own house, how shall he take care of the church of God? Satan attacks marriage first. - The rebellion in a household mirrors Israel's rebellion against Christ. **[Jeremiah 30:11](/bible/jeremiah/30#v11)** *[[23:01](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=1381s)]* > [11](/bible/jeremiah/30#v11) For I am with thee, saith the Lord, to save thee: though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee: but I will correct thee in measure, and will not leave thee altogether unpunished. - Though I make a full end of all nations whither I have scattered thee, yet will I not make a full end of thee, but I will correct thee in measure. Israel is in that correction now, and only Israel will remain. **[Hosea 4:1](/bible/hosea/4#v1)** *[[31:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=1875s)]* > [1](/bible/hosea/4#v1) Hear the word of the Lord, ye children of Israel: for the Lord hath a controversy with the inhabitants of the land, because there is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land. - There is no truth, nor mercy, nor knowledge of God in the land: swearing, lying, killing, stealing and adultery. All of it followed when the first order of marriage was broken. **[Psalms 127:1](/bible/psalms/127#v1)** *[[41:54](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=2514s)]* > [1](/bible/psalms/127#v1) Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain. - Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it. Marriage built on the world's doctrines will not stand. - Children are a heritage of the Lord when they come from a lawful union, and they shall speak with the enemies in the gate. **[2 Corinthians 6:17](/bible/2-corinthians/6#v17)** *[[47:15](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=2835s)]* > [17](/bible/2-corinthians/6#v17) Wherefore come out from among them, and be ye separate, saith the Lord, and touch not the unclean thing; and I will receive you, - Come out from among them and be ye separate, and I will receive you and be a father unto you. The congregation becomes father and mother to those who come in with no parents to teach them. Precepts: - **[1 Peter 5:5](/bible/1-peter/5#v5)** > [5](/bible/1-peter/5#v5) Likewise, ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. Yea, all of you be subject one to another, and be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud, and giveth grace to the humble. Ye younger, submit yourselves unto the elder. - **[1 Timothy 5:2](/bible/1-timothy/5#v2)** > [2](/bible/1-timothy/5#v2) The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity. The elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, with all purity. **[Hebrews 13:4](/bible/hebrews/13#v4)** *[[58:47](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=3527s)]* > [4](/bible/hebrews/13#v4) Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge. - Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge. - Courtship is for making sure your minds agree before the marriage, not only for intimacy. A child of a lawful union is born into a celebration, not chaos. **[Wisdom of Solomon 4:6](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/4#v6)** *[[1:09:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=4160s)]* > [6](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/4#v6) For children begotten of unlawful beds are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial. - Children begotten of unlawful beds are witnesses of wickedness against their parents in their trial. **[John 9:1](/bible/john/9#v1)** *[[1:16:42](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=4602s)]* > [1](/bible/john/9#v1) And as Jesus passed by, he saw a man which was blind from his birth. - The man born blind was not paying for his own sin; God used him to show his power. Do not presume on God's mercy and play with his judgment. Precepts: - **[Matthew 23:32](/bible/matthew/23#v32)** > [32](/bible/matthew/23#v32) Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers. Fill ye up then the measure of your fathers. - **[Exodus 34:7](/bible/exodus/34#v7)** > [7](/bible/exodus/34#v7) Keeping mercy for thousands, forgiving iniquity and transgression and sin, and that will by no means clear the guilty; visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children, and upon the children’s children, unto the third and to the fourth generation. Visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and to the fourth generation. **[Acts 1:6](/bible/acts/1#v6)** *[[1:28:18](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=5298s)]* > [6](/bible/acts/1#v6) When they therefore were come together, they asked of him, saying, Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel? - Lord, wilt thou at this time restore again the kingdom to Israel? The kingdom will not return until the men are in their proper order. - The husband is the head of the wife, as Christ is the head of the church. There is no glory for the women unless the men have theirs. Precepts: - **[Ephesians 5:23](/bible/ephesians/5#v23)** > [23](/bible/ephesians/5#v23) For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church: and he is the saviour of the body. The husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church. **[Luke 17:20](/bible/luke/17#v20)** *[[1:35:20](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=5720s)]* > [20](/bible/luke/17#v20) And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come, he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation: - The kingdom of God cometh not with observation; the kingdom of God is within you. - In the beginning the earth existed first in God's mind. Made in his image, Israel can organize the kingdom in its mind before it is built. Precepts: - **[Genesis 1:2](/bible/genesis/1#v2)** > [2](/bible/genesis/1#v2) And the earth was without form and void; and darkness was upon the face of the deep. And the Spirit of God moved upon the face of the waters. The earth was without form, and void; and God said, Let there be light. **[Matthew 11:12](/bible/matthew/11#v12)** *[[1:43:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=6204s)]* > [12](/bible/matthew/11#v12) And from the days of John the Baptist until now the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force. - From the days of John the Baptist the kingdom of heaven suffereth violence, and the violent take it by force. - They took it by breaking the family: separating the woman from her husband and removing his comfort, strength and reverence. **[1 Timothy 2:12](/bible/1-timothy/2#v12)** *[[1:48:24](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=6504s)]* > [12](/bible/1-timothy/2#v12) But I suffer not a woman to teach, nor to usurp authority over the man, but to be in silence. - I suffer not a woman to usurp authority over the man. For Adam was first formed, then Eve, and the woman being deceived was in the transgression. - She shall be saved in childbearing if she continue in faith, charity and holiness with sobriety. **[Sirach 26:26](/bible/sirach/26#v26)** *[[1:54:50](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=6890s)]* > [26](/bible/sirach/26#v26) A woman that honoureth her husband shall be judged wise of all; but she that dishonoureth him in her pride shall be counted ungodly of all. - A woman that honoureth her husband shall be judged wise of all, but she that dishonoureth him in her pride shall be counted ungodly. - Reverence is deep respect laced with awe; its opposite is contempt. Precepts: - **[Ephesians 5:33](/bible/ephesians/5#v33)** > [33](/bible/ephesians/5#v33) Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband. Let every one of you so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband. **[Wisdom of Solomon 3:10](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/3#v10)** *[[2:38:25](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=9505s)]* > [10](/bible/wisdom-of-solomon/3#v10) But the ungodly shall be punished according to their own imaginations, which have neglected the righteous, and forsaken the Lord. - The ungodly which have neglected the righteous shall be punished; their wives are foolish and their children wicked. **[1 Peter 3:7](/bible/1-peter/3#v7)** *[[2:46:11](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=9971s)]* > [7](/bible/1-peter/3#v7) Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel, and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered. - Husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife as unto the weaker vessel. The man has the preeminence to make the house right. - Every man should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour, and wash his wife with the water of the word. Precepts: - **[1 Thessalonians 4:4](/bible/1-thessalonians/4#v4)** > [4](/bible/1-thessalonians/4#v4) That every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour; Every one of you should know how to possess his vessel in sanctification and honour. - **[Ephesians 5:26](/bible/ephesians/5#v26)** > [26](/bible/ephesians/5#v26) That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word, That he might sanctify and cleanse it with the washing of water by the word. ## Class Questions - **Why does the class start with marriage to rebuild the kingdom?** Every sin followed the break between Adam and Eve, and a husband and wife are the first organization of a nation. Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain (Psalm 127:1). - **How did the violent take the kingdom by force?** By breaking the Israelite family, separating the woman from her husband and stripping the man of comfort and reverence, as the Willie Lynch letter describes (Matthew 11:12). - **What is reverence, and what is its opposite?** Deep respect laced with awe for the husband, as Ephesians 5:33 commands. Its opposite is contempt. - **What do children of unlawful beds testify?** They are witnesses of wickedness against their parents (Wisdom of Solomon 4:6). - **Where is the kingdom of God, according to Luke 17:21?** Within you. Made in God's image, Israel can organize the kingdom in its mind before building it. ## In Closing *[[2:53:41](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg&t=10421s)]* Marriage is the pinnacle of everything else, and it has to be fixed before the kingdom can be restored. The series continues on Bible Book of Our Fathers. ## Announcements & References - Subscribe to Bible Book of Our Fathers, where the marriage series continues. --- [Class Notes Index](/classes) · [Watch the full session on YouTube ↗](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QxWHRujbdpg)
